title: Frozen SWAP 4.3.1 Surface-Water State, Control, Exchange and Mass Inventory

legacy_execution_order.pre_soil_water: SurfaceWater task 2 evaluates drainflux_extended, optional DIVDRA and qdrtot before SoilWater
legacy_execution_order.soil_water_trial: SoilWater task 2 consumes the resulting drainage distribution and may alter runoff/rapid-drainage terms
legacy_execution_order.post_soil_water: SurfaceWater task 3 resolves prescribed water levels or advances WLEVBAL after SoilWater
legacy_execution_order.retry_behavior: legacy timestep reduction can cause the loop to repeat; modern composition must ensure rejected trials do not commit surface-water state or mass

immutable_parameters.modern_role: surface-water topology/mode configuration supplied from outside the kernel; not dynamic state
immutable per-level channel and exchange parameters
prepared immutable storage-level relation; legacy 22-point table is derived from channel geometry and is not state
physical management/control parameters and event schedule description; calendar parsing remains outside kernel
numerical oscillation-detection policy parameter, explicitly separate from physical surface-water configuration

committed_physical_state.notes: primary physical state; storage change must close exactly with accepted transfers

committed_physical_state.required_when: automatic management SWMAN=2 can retain previous target between adjustment events
committed_physical_state.notes: continuation-critical because the legacy branch reuses the previous target between adjustment events

derived_or_forced_hydraulic_quantities.modern_rule: do not duplicate SWST and WLS as independent committed physical states; derive level from authoritative storage for simulated mode
prescribed primary-system water level resolved by adapter/runtime at the requested interval time

numerical_history.modern_role: optional numerical-policy continuation history for oscillation detection
numerical_history.transactional_requirement: if reference numerical-route continuity requires it, it must rollback with rejected trials and remain separate from physical state

diagnostics_not_state.modern_role: diagnostic adjustment counter; not needed to continue physical state

trial_results_or_scratch.modern_role: signed trial transfer results, never persistent physical state
trial balance/control scratch and explicit result values where physically meaningful

storage_level_relation.legacy_construction: STTAB has 22 levels: +100 cm, 0 cm, then 20 evenly spaced levels to the deepest secondary channel bottom; storage is accumulated from open-channel geometry divided by spacing
storage_level_relation.forward_relation: SWSTLEV(level) uses piecewise-linear interpolation in STTAB
storage_level_relation.inverse_relation: WLEVST(storage) uses piecewise-linear inverse interpolation in the same table
storage_level_relation.architectural_consequence: the prepared relation belongs to immutable parameter/preparation data; only SWST needs to be conserved for simulated secondary water

extended_exchange_physics.surface_water_head_selection: secondary levels use WLS and primary levels use WLP when SWSRF>=2
extended_exchange_physics.active_channel_condition: exchange evaluated when either groundwater or surface-water level is sufficiently above channel bottom and the ponding-sill condition allows the route
extended_exchange_physics.head_difference: diffl = gwl - resolved drain level, with ponding added when gwl > -0.1 cm
extended_exchange_physics.infiltration_cap: if diffl<0 and gwl<GWLINF, legacy replaces gwl contribution by GWLINF before computing infiltration
extended_exchange_physics.open_channel_resistance: for SWDTYP=2, entry/exit resistance is scaled by channel spacing / wetted perimeter
extended_exchange_physics.rapid_surface_drainage: highest-level SWNRSRF=1 varies drainage resistance between RSURFDEEP and RSURFSHALLOW
holds: Do not combine availability limiting with the constitutive exchange law.
Do not claim negative/undefined power-interflow behavior outside separately qualified domain.
Do not expose legacy global WETPER/DRAINL scratch as process state.

availability_limiter.legacy_behavior: before SoilWater, simulated secondary storage may proportionally scale secondary-system drainage/infiltration transfers when projected storage plus maximum supply would fall below zero
availability_limiter.formula_basis: projected storage = SWST + (QDRD + WSCAP)*dt; if negative, set QDRD to exactly the available withdrawal rate and scale all secondary level transfers by one ratio
availability_limiter.classification: state-dependent physical coupling limiter, not constitutive drainage resistance and not numerical solver policy
availability_limiter.modern_requirement: preserve one authoritative limited signed transfer and expose the limiter decision in diagnostics; no hidden renormalization after mass booking

secondary_storage_balance.authoritative_modern_balance: S1-S0 = dt*(q_drain_secondary + q_rapid + q_supply - q_discharge) + V_top_surface_exchange

signs.q_drain_secondary: positive soil/drainage system to secondary surface water; negative secondary surface water to soil
signs.q_supply: positive external supply into secondary surface water
signs.q_discharge: positive external discharge out of secondary surface water
signs.V_top_surface_exchange: positive soil-surface/runoff amount into secondary surface water; negative inundation amount from secondary surface water to soil surface

secondary_storage_balance.critical_modernization: legacy WDIS is local scratch and actual supply is not published as a first-class flux; modern implementation must explicitly return supply and discharge so accepted mass ledger closure is observable rather than inferred

management_policy.fixed_weir: SWMAN=1 uses HBWEIR as target and a level-discharge relation to resolve overflow/discharge
management_policy.automatic_weir: SWMAN=2 periodically selects a target level using groundwater level, total soil air volume, selected-node pressure head and management thresholds, with a maximum target drop rate
management_policy.target_memory: between adjustment events automatic management reuses prior WLSTAR
management_policy.generic_time_requirement: legacy day/calendar expressions must be translated to explicit event times outside the kernel; no implicit midnight/day stepping is allowed
management_policy.hydraulic_view_requirement: automatic control may use GWL, water content/air-volume summary and a selected pressure head through a clean qualified view; it must not depend on HeadCalc internals

required_trial_order: capture committed soil-water and optional surface-water/control state
resolve forcing and physical control events for [t0,t1]
derive WLS from committed/trial SWST when simulated and resolve WLP/WLS forcing when prescribed
apply state-dependent secondary-storage availability limiter before publishing soil drainage source/sink
spatially distribute the authoritative limited exchange through the qualified DIVDRA seam when active
solve soil-water trial, including signed top-surface exchange and optional rapid drainage
advance trial surface-water storage/control balance using the same accepted trial transfers
if either soil-water or surface-water policy requests retry, discard all trial physical state, numerical history and uncommitted mass
on acceptance, atomically commit soil-water state, surface-water state/control memory and accepted mass-ledger entries
transactional_composition.rollback_requirement: no rejected trial may alter SWST, WLSTAR, any reference numerical history, or the accepted mass ledger
transactional_composition.warm_start_requirement: numerical guesses may be reused, but the physical trial must restart from the correct committed state

source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.observation: drainflux_extended assigns local WL only when SWSRF>=2 but subsequently evaluates a condition containing WL also on the SWSRF=1 route; local variables are SAVE'd but WL has no explicit initialization
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.risk: potential undefined-value dependence in a legacy-admitted route
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.disposition: hold SWSRF=1 extended route from direct production migration until independently characterized

source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.observation: automatic-weir capacity check uses current WLS for SWQHR=1 but WLSTAR for SWQHR=2
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.risk: source-level branch asymmetry may be intentional or a legacy discrepancy
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.disposition: require theory/source/equation-level qualification before automatic-weir candidate

source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.observation: WDIS is local and actual supply is not materialized as a persistent/public flux even where storage is assigned using supply assumptions
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.risk: legacy output structure obscures explicit external mass attribution
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.disposition: modern component must emit first-class q_supply and q_discharge and prove balance closure branch-by-branch

source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.observation: automatic-management adjustment cadence is expressed using integer day arithmetic and management-period dates
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.risk: direct migration would violate generic-time invariant
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.disposition: translate to explicit event schedule outside kernel and qualify equivalent event timing

source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.observation: WLSBAK/OSSWLM affect timestep reduction through oscillation detection but are not physical storage/control state
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.risk: copying them into surface-water physical state would mix physics and numerical policy
source_level_risks_requiring_child_dispo.disposition: separate optional numerical continuation history from committed physical state
